name: opensky
description: Opensky is an opensource Skyrim custom engine converter to run the Elder Scrolls V Skyrim on the Ps Vita and lesser hardware
long_description: OpenSKY is a standalone, original game engine for the PS Vita (C, VitaSDK + vitaGL), written from scratch - no publisher code, decompiled or leaked. It plays nothing on its own: it runs data that its converter makes from **your own legally purchased, installed** copy of Skyrim Special Edition (Steam or GOG; the converter checks for one and refuses to run without it).
